verdict.rationale: Perplexity ships a documented MCP server (remote hosted and local stdio variants) plus explicit guidance for tool-restriction and using it in Messages/Agent API tool-call flows, official SDKs with type-safe request/response schemas, an OpenAPI spec, and a CLI that outputs JSON for shell/agent pipelines — all directly enabling agent-framework consumption as a ready-made tool. Missing for 10: independent third-party confirmation of successful agent-framework integration (e.g., LangChain/AutoGen usage reports) beyond vendor docs.
